display_long_description:
Third Seat is an AI-powered VR experience for couples and solo participants who want to practice communication, emotional awareness, and reflection through guided roleplay.

Enter a calming virtual space and speak with Mira, an AI guide who facilitates thoughtful conversation. Mira listens to your real-time voice, reflects on what’s shared, and offers summaries and prompts to deepen understanding. Sessions can be experienced with a partner or individually as a space for reflection and communication practice.

Think of Third Seat as a practice space for real conversations - a place to improve empathy, listening, and emotional insight.

To begin a session, simply walk up to Mira in the room.

Key Features

• Solo or multiplayer VR sessions
• AI-powered guide Mira (OpenAI + Azure Speech)
• Real-time voice transcription and conversational summaries
• Save and resume sessions with full context
• Privacy-first design - voice is processed, not stored

Third Seat is designed for personal growth, roleplay, and skill-building. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, or provide therapy for any medical or mental health condition.

Privacy Policy
We collect only the data needed for session continuity. Voice is processed, not stored. Deletion requests available. Full policy:
thirdseat.notion.site/privacy-policy-for-third-seat

Contact
ThirdSeatSupport@proton.me
